titles: 5 Questions to Answer Before You Retire
How to Know If You Can Afford to Retire
You Could Probably Retire Sooner Than You Think
description: You might be closer to retirement than you think — or overlooking something that puts it at risk.
Aaron Christopherson, CFP®, walks through the five questions he wants answered before anyone retires, and why the people who retire confidently aren't always the ones with the most money.
• Building your retirement number from your lifestyle, not your salary
• Why a portfolio built for accumulation can fail in a down market
• What health insurance before 65 really costs, and why it isn't a reason to keep working
• Having something meaningful to retire to
• Whether your spouse would be financially okay without you
